title: The HOA President Fined Me $50 for My Mailbox… So I Read the Rulebook
hook: She fined me $50 for my mailbox color… big mistake
story: Our HOA president fined me fifty dollars because my mailbox was "the wrong shade of white." Not a different color. The wrong shade of white. When I asked her which shade was correct, she said, "The one in the rulebook." So I asked for the rulebook. She sent me a PDF that was one hundred and twelve pages long, clearly expecting me to give up. I didn't give up. I read every single page. Twice. Page eight: there is no approved shade of white. The rulebook just says "white or neutral." Fine canceled. But I kept reading. Page forty-one: the HOA president must be a homeowner living in the neighborhood. And I happened to know that her house was owned by her sister, who lives three states away. I printed page forty-one, highlighted it, and brought it to the next HOA meeting. I didn't say a word. I just passed it around. The room went quiet. One neighbor asked her directly. She didn't have an answer. They held an emergency vote that same night. She was removed. And then somebody in the back said, "Well, who actually read the rulebook?" Every head turned to look at me. So now I'm the HOA president. And my first rule? Paint your mailbox any shade of white you want.
description:
Never fine the person who reads the whole rulebook. 📖
